name: Block-Sparse Attention (Sol-Attn / SLA / VSA)
plain: Replaces dense self-attention with a block-sparse kernel from comfy_kitchen, where each query block attends exactly to a chosen subset of key blocks. Three selection modes: an adaptive per-head threshold (sol-attn), a fixed top percent (sla), and 3D video-cube tiling with a learned coarse branch (vsa). Falls back to the dense backend outside the sigma window, under the token minimum, on listed blocks, or when dtype/head_dim/device don't fit.
math:
Dense if σ∉[σ_end,σ_start], tokens<min_tokens(12288), block∈dense_blocks, mask given, not CUDA, kernel unavailable, dtype∉{bf16,fp16,fp32}, head_dim≠128, q,k,v shapes differ.
Otherwise ck.sol_attn(q,k,v,tau,topk_ratio,sink_blocks,sink_q,token_aug). Block size 64 tokens. topk_ratio=0 for sol-attn, keep_percent/100 else. The kernel itself is in comfy_kitchen and was not read here.
MiniMax H3: block replace feeds a chunked qkv producer (4096-token slices) with pooled kmean/vscale carried from the previous step, per (block,n,uuids).
H3 sinks: packed text/audio/ref rows kept exact for every query; exact_kv_and_rows also keeps audio query rows dense.
VSA: 4×4×4 cubes padded to 64-row tiles, requires an H3 layout; extra_tokens forced to 0.

props.hook: transformer_options['optimized_attention_override'] (reinstalled each step by ON_PREPARE_STATE) + set_model_patch_replace('dit','double_block',i) on H3
props.architectures: Generic: any model routing attention through the override with head_dim 128. Special path only for MiniMaxH3Model; VSA raises on anything else.
